_comment: Floors measured on the committed fixtures, set just below the observed run so a real regression fails the build and a rounding difference does not. Raise them after a genuine improvement; changing the embedding model means re-recording and re-setting them deliberately.
_measuredOn: v3 batch A.4 — paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 (in-process ONNX, 384 dim), route-similarity-threshold 0.25, cache threshold 0.92
_cacheFalseNegativeNote: The two cache false-negative ceilings were LOOSENED (0.57 -> 0.66, 0.48 -> 0.64) when the embedding model changed. At the same fixed 0.92 the new model refuses more servable pairs and serves fewer wrong ones: FP 16.1% -> 14.3% on the test half, FN 45.5% -> 61.4%. The threshold is a constant on a similarity scale that moved, and 0.92 was kept because correctness is the side this cache errs on. The false-positive ceilings tighten in the same commit, which is the other half of that trade.
_conversationNote: v4 A.1 recorded the conversation blind spot as it was: every cross-context case served (64/64, similarity 1.0), same-context hits 11.1% / 33.3%. v4 A.2 scopes the cache by conversation context (ADR 0014): the four cross-context ceilings drop to 0 and hold there. The price is on the other side and is recorded, not hidden: same-context-paraphrase falls to 5.6% (1/18) because conversations with two prior exchanges now bypass the cache (gatewai.cache.max-history-messages=3); first-turn-paraphrase is unchanged at 33.3%. Floors set just below the measured values.
